title: 第5章 搬新家了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
郁嘉庆备受感动，他没想到多年未见的父亲，才见面第一天，便将他救醒了，还给他买了一套房。

    曾经以为自己和母亲被父亲抛弃的想法，简直可笑。

    郁嘉庆拿出自己随身携带的身份证递给站在一旁不敢做声的主管。

    虽然主管很疑惑，为什么这个年纪大的看上去像父亲的人却对着一个比他年轻二十岁的人叫爸，但想来这些有钱人的乐趣，可能自己是真的不懂吧。

    “郁先生，您的身份证也要拿出来，我这边需要登记转账人的信息。”主管恭敬的说。

    郁凡拿出自己的临时身份证递给售楼主管。

    “1962年出生？”售楼主管瞪大了眼睛。

    售楼主管疑惑的看向郁凡，郁嘉庆连忙说：“是的，我父亲今年已经60岁了。”

    售楼主管怀疑的看了看郁凡和郁嘉庆，原来这真的是两父子？

    现在的医美技术都这么好了吗？！

    听了售楼主管和郁家父子的对话，原本有点小心思的于璐想法淡了一些。

    原本以为是个有钱的公子哥，想着自己若是勾搭一番，应该是少不了自己的好处的。

    可如今才知道，原来这个看似年轻的人居然已经60岁了！

    虽然外表很英俊，但自己还是很难过这个槛。

    想想自己即将到手的几十万提成，已经非常好了！做人可不要太贪心。

    把所有购房合同都签完后，售楼主管将手中的钥匙递给了郁嘉庆。

    “郁先生，这是备用钥匙，现在可以录入指纹，房子都是精装修的，可以随时拎包入住，装修风格若是有不喜欢的，可以重新装修。”

    郁嘉庆拿过钥匙，内心激荡不已。

    他真的成为了这个楼王的主人！

    “现在天都快黑了，孩子们也该回来了，我们去接上素华和孩子们，今晚便住过来。”

    郁凡可不想让自己的后辈们都住在那个疙瘩角落。

    两人回去的路上，郁凡不由的再次感叹，还是得赶紧买辆车。

    果然两人回到家中的时候，三个孩子已经回来了。

    盛素华已经对孩子们讲过爷爷回来的事情，并且告知了孩子们爷爷看上去很年轻，让孩子做足了心理准备。
content_en:
Yu Jiaqing was deeply moved. He did not expect that his father, whom he had not seen for many years, would wake him up on the first day they met and buy him a house.

The idea that I and my mother had been abandoned by my father was simply ridiculous.

Yu Jiaqing took out the ID card he carried with him and handed it to the supervisor who stood aside and did not dare to say anything.

Although the supervisor was very puzzled as to why this older man who looked like his father called him daddy to a man who was twenty years younger than him, he probably didn't understand the fun of these rich people.

"Mr. Yu, you also need to show your ID card. I need to register the transferee's information." The supervisor said respectfully.

Yu Fan took out his temporary ID card and handed it to the sales manager.

"Born in 1962?" The sales manager's eyes widened.

The sales manager looked at Yu Fan doubtfully, and Yu Jiaqing quickly said, "Yes, my father is 60 years old this year."

The sales manager looked at Yu Fan and Yu Jiaqing suspiciously. It turned out that they were really two father and son?

Are today’s medical aesthetics technologies so good?!

After listening to the conversation between the sales manager and the Yu family's father and son, Yu Lu, who was originally a little cautious, became less thoughtful.

I originally thought he was a rich young man, and thought that if he hooked up with him, he would benefit from it.

But now I know that this seemingly young man is actually 60 years old!

Although he looks very handsome, it is still difficult for him to pass this threshold.

Thinking about the hundreds of thousands of commissions that I am about to receive, it is already very good!Don't be too greedy in life.

After all the house purchase contracts were signed, the sales manager handed the key to Yu Jiaqing.

"Mr. Yu, this is a spare key. You can enter your fingerprint now. The house is fully decorated and you can move in at any time. If you don't like the decoration style, you can redecorate it."

Yu Jiaqing took the key and was filled with excitement.

He really became the master of this building!

"It's almost dark now, and it's time for the children to come back. Let's pick up Suhua and the children, and we'll stay here tonight."

Yu Fan didn't want his descendants to live in that lumpy corner.

On their way back, Yu Fan couldn't help but sigh again, he still had to buy a car quickly.

Sure enough, when the two returned home, the three children had already returned.

Sheng Suhua has already told the children about grandpa's return and told them that grandpa looks very young, so that the children can be mentally prepared.
title_en: Chapter 5 Moving to a new home
